title: Dungeon integration: smoke route, screenshot tour stops, performance pass, docs
player_outcome: The whole Skeletron-and-Dungeon arc is exercised end to end on every CI run and stays smooth while exploring.
design: keeper at the gate at night, Skeletron with hands, hands then head;
the Guardian is gone after the flag;
shaft bottom, a library ('assert near.blue_brick > 0' or the matching colour via a zone probe), a spike strip hurting, a locked chest opened with a key, the bound mechanic present;

game/Testing/Tours/tour.cmds gains dungeon stops: keep facade at noon, foyer, a winding hall with banners, a library, a treasure room. game/Testing/Tours/bosses.cmds shows Skeletron with detached hands.

Perf pass: with 'perf' commands on Small at the medium preset, walk from the gate to the vault. Targets: no frame over 33 ms attributable to gd.objects, prop loads or collider rebuilds; plan time for the Large dungeon < 150 ms. Fix hotspots, e.g. raise the preload distance or cut object variety.

Docs: docs/architecture/worldgen.md (the dungeon planner, builder phases, decorator, planned wires, NoZone). docs/architecture/gameplay.md (boss parts, Expert context, enrage, treasure bags, locks, hazards, natural arrivals). docs/architecture/content-and-assets.md (boss icons, trophies, dungeon generators). The docs/3D_TERRARIA_MASTER_PLAN.md status table.
tests: Smoke dungeon.cmds (extended) prints SMOKE PASS in CI (Tiny).
Screenshot tour (Small, lavapipe) completes with the new shots.
verification: lavapipe tour: xvfb-run godot --rendering-driver vulkan ... --smoke=res://game/Testing/Tours/tour.cmds; review the dungeon shots against Terraria reference imagery
risks: Smoke runtime grows. Keep dungeon.cmds under the 600 s CI timeout by using landmarks rather than walking.
